# dshell

**Tag**: web, ui, tooling

## 简介

An API and dev environment for writing console apps/scripts using dart. e.g. allows you to build bash style scripts with dart.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/bsutton/dshell
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/dshell
